info.title: Phantera API
info.description: Contract between the Phantera back and its fronts. Generated from @phantera/contract: do not edit.

get.summary: Recent activity of the workspace (sends, opens, replies), newest first. Empty list without access.

post.summary: AI ICP advisor: from a product description, suggest titles, company sizes and geos.
Campaign in 60 seconds: derive a whole campaign setup from the homepage of a website.
Generate a full outreach sequence, streamed as Server-Sent Events (one event per step).

get.summary: What the Analyst screen needs: availability, monthly quota, own conversations, comparable campaigns, suggestions.

post.summary: One question to the Analyst, answered as Server-Sent Events (progress, then answer or failure).

delete.summary: Delete one of the asker's own conversations for good.

get.summary: One of the asker's own conversations with its messages (404 if not theirs).
Questions drawn from the diagnoses of the asker's campaigns (empty when the plan cannot ask).
Start the Google OAuth consent flow (302 to Google; to /dashboard/settings?mailbox=error&reason=… when access or step-up fails).
Start the Microsoft OAuth consent flow (302 to Microsoft; to /dashboard/settings?mailbox=error&reason=… when access or step-up fails).

post.summary: Create a campaign from the wizard: AI prospecting is queued in the background; on existing leads, step 1 is queued at once.
Opt-in: send step 1 to qualified leads whose email could not be verified (unknown status).
Queue step 1 for every qualifying lead, mark the campaign ACTIVE and start the sending queue.
Send now: start the sending queue right away for the campaign's queued messages.

get.summary: Queued messages, the limit holding them (if any) and when sending resumes.
The campaign's "send from" mailbox and alias.

patch.summary: Change the campaign's sender (null mailbox = workspace default); applies from the next email.
Pause, resume or complete a campaign.

get.summary: Per-step analytics of a campaign (sent, delivered, opened, clicked, failed, rates).

patch.summary: Edit a sequence step (subject, body, delay, LinkedIn invite note) while some lead has not received it; step 1 keeps J+0.

get.summary: Multichannel accounts visible to the caller (pending ones are reconciled with Unipile first).

delete.summary: Disconnect a channel (its owner or an admin) and revoke the Unipile account.

post.summary: Start connecting a channel: returns the Unipile hosted-auth URL (WhatsApp is refused with 400).
Mark a reply as read (Business plan and above, else 402).

get.summary: Unread replies for the sidebar badge (0 on plans without the inbox).
Open alerts the caller may see, number of snoozed ones and recent actions taken.

post.summary: Take one of the alert's one-click actions (pause, change sender, skip segment, duplicate).
Silence one alert for 7 or 30 days.
Undo an action taken from an alert.
Join the workspace of an invitation (HTML form post): 303 to /dashboard with that workspace active; 303 back to /invite/[token]?error=CODE on refusal, to sign-in without a session.

get.summary: Keep a valid invitation in a short-lived cookie, then redirect to Clerk sign-up (default) or sign-in.
After sign-in/up: back to the kept invitation (cookie consumed), else to /dashboard.
Leads of a workspace (best 500), searchable across the whole base.

post.summary: Send a one-off LinkedIn DM (falls back to a connection invitation carrying the message).

patch.summary: Set or clear the lead phone (international form; empty string clears it).

get.summary: Phone lookup state of a lead for the lead panel.

post.summary: Start the Apollo phone lookup (paid, monthly quota).

patch.summary: Update the status and/or the do-not-contact flag of a lead.

get.summary: The last 10 WhatsApp/SMS messages sent to the lead.

post.summary: Record a WhatsApp/SMS message the user just sent from their phone.
Draft the WhatsApp or SMS message the user will send from their phone.
Assign leads to a campaign (campaignId null unassigns).

get.summary: Leads free to start a campaign (no campaign, contactable, FAST_TRACK or NORMAL), best 500.

post.summary: Verify the emails of up to 25 leads (Hunter); leads verified in the last 30 days are skipped.
Verify the email of one lead (Hunter) and store the enrichment.
Record a browser-side CSV export of leads in the audit log.

get.summary: Hot leads (qualified / positive reply), cursor-paginated (limit capped at 50).

post.summary: Create (or update, by email) a single lead by hand.
AI-score up to 100 leads against their campaign targeting (forced rescoring).
Full sourcing pipeline (Apollo, Hunter, AI scoring) streamed as SSE; each event is `data: <json>`.

delete.summary: Disconnect a mailbox. 409 MAILBOX_IN_USE (campaigns, total) unless force=1, which pauses them.

get.summary: Mailboxes visible to the caller (own + shared; all for admins). Plan quota travels in X-Mailbox-Limit / X-Mailbox-Plan headers.

patch.summary: Set default mailbox, daily cap, warm-up, or team sharing (admins only).

post.summary: Sync Gmail send-as aliases, or add/remove an SMTP alias.

get.summary: Addresses a campaign can be sent from (mailboxes + aliases) and the plan quota.

post.summary: Test then save a custom SMTP mailbox (upsert by workspace + email).
Poll the caller's Gmail/Outlook mailboxes for new replies now.

get.summary: Notifications of the caller (newest first) and the unread count.

post.summary: Mark one notification as read.
Mark every unread notification as read.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events: `event: notification` per new notification; closes after 20 s, EventSource reconnects.

post.summary: First-run setup: create the signed-in user's workspace if needed, name it and mark onboarding complete.

get.summary: Audit log, newest first: a page of 50 as JSON. With format=csv, the whole retained log as a CSV file (10 per hour).
Security options of the workspace.

patch.summary: Require two-factor for the team (owner only; turning it on needs the owner's own second factor, else 409 OWN_TWO_FACTOR_MISSING).

post.summary: Answers 200 when the session verified its factors recently, else Clerk's reverification error.
Stripe Checkout URL for a plan; an already paying workspace switches plan in place and gets the success URL.
Stripe Customer Portal URL.

get.summary: Members of the active workspace; pending invitations only for those who manage the team.

post.summary: Invite someone by e-mail; the link is mailed and returned once.

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave (leaving one's own seat needs no step-up). With transferTo, resources go to that admin; otherwise campaigns pause.

post.summary: Mark a queued message as sent (body = message as possibly edited).
Pass over a queued message: the sequence goes on to its next step.

get.summary: Queued WhatsApp/SMS drafts (up to 100); `?count=1` returns only the number (sidebar badge).
"À envoyer" page: queued WhatsApp/SMS drafts (up to 100) and the sends left today (`{ redirect }` without lead access).
Analytics page: aggregated figures over the visible campaigns, filtered by period (p), campaigns (c) and comparison (vs) (`{ redirect }` without workspace access).
Campaign detail page: campaign figures, step stats, first 100 leads and counts. 404 outside the member's scope; `{ redirectTo }` without campaign access.
Campaigns page: campaigns of the member's scope with their figures, and e-mails left this month (empty without campaign access).
Dashboard home: first name and real-time stats of what the viewer may see (`{ redirect }` without workspace access).
Dashboard layout: where to send the visitor (pending invitation, onboarding, sign-in) or the active workspace and the user's workspaces.
History page: notifications and campaign events, newest first (empty without workspace access).
Hot leads page: 50 hottest leads, their count and the workspace funnel; `redirectTo` without lead access.
Reply Inbox page: one page of replies (Business plan and above, else `locked`); `redirectTo` without inbox access.
Invitation page: the invitation and what the visitor can do with it, or invalid (expired, used, revoked, unknown).
Leads page: first leads of the base, campaigns, plan and real total (empty base on FREE without lead access).
Onboarding layout: ready for a user still to set up, else where to send them (pending invitation, dashboard).
Settings page: profile, workspace, security access and billing (Stripe identifiers for billing managers only).

post.summary: Switch the active workspace (signed cookie).

delete.summary: Cancel a scheduled deletion within the grace period.

get.summary: Whether a deletion of the workspace is scheduled, and when.

post.summary: Schedule the deletion of the workspace (owner, recent verification, name typed).

get.summary: Recent exports of the workspace (10 max), with a signed link for the ready ones.

post.summary: Ask for a full export, built in the background (one at a time, 3 per day). Answers 202.

get.summary: Download a ready export (application/zip). Needs the signed link (e, s) and a recent verification; redirects to settings otherwise.
Onboarding status and ICP settings (null workspace when access is denied).

patch.summary: Update the ICP and sending domain (only provided fields; empty domain clears it).

get.summary: Pro email signature of the workspace (null when none).

put.summary: Save the pro email signature (links must read as web addresses).

delete.summary: Remove the Brevo key and SMS settings.

get.summary: Automatic SMS settings (Brevo) and remaining credits. The key is never returned.

put.summary: Save the SMS settings. Setting a new apiKey requires a recent step-up; pausing or renaming the sender does not.
